body:
Create a precise 6-frame gameplay BODY-only animation sprite sheet for approved Kennyo03, fixed 3 columns x 2 rows (1536x1024, each cell 512x512). Reference 1 is idle body; reference 2 approved character face/costume. Preserve face, white hood, pointed beard, charcoal monk clothing, dark chest and hip armor, thin gold cloth strip, pants, shin guards, sandals. IMPORTANT: REMOVE THE ENTIRE BROWN PRAYER BEAD NECKLACE FROM THE BODY in every frame, exposing normal armor/robe beneath. He is now using that necklace as a separate giant whip weapon which will be composited later. DO NOT draw ANY beads, chain, weapon, shaft, FX, speed lines, shadows, labels or background. Only the man, empty gripping hands, true RGBA transparency.
Same realistic hand-painted game sprite style; exactly same anatomy/head scale in all cells, 420 px standing-equivalent figure within each 512 cell, feet soles baseline y=474. Fixed side-scroller waist-height camera; no camera rotation/zoom. Entire figure and both hands completely inside each cell, no cropping. Feet remain in a broad planted stance and knees flex naturally; the torso rotates left and right while hips and legs stay connected. This is side-to-side WHIPPING, NOT a 360 spin, NOT jumping.
He holds the short grip of an invisible flexible bead loop in one lead fist, the other hand is a distinct balancing fist near chest. Show a clear FORCEFUL sequence:
1. Wind-up for RIGHTWARD whip: torso twists toward screen-left, lead RIGHT fist pulled back near his left shoulder (left side of image), elbow bent, other hand near sternum; face turned toward target to right.
2. Mid RIGHTWARD whip: hips begin untwisting right, lead right elbow moving across chest, fist at center front around lower sternum; cloth lags left.
3. RIGHTWARD strike endpoint: lead right arm extends strongly toward screen-right at lower chest height, fist visible far right of torso; torso leans slightly right, left fist guards chest. Planted feet no sliding.
4. Wind-up reverse: extended right hand bends slightly and rises at screen-right, torso loads to right for reverse whip, left hand now assisting near right wrist, same legs.
5. Mid LEFTWARD whip: torso turns frontward, right fist sweeps back across abdomen toward screen-left, elbow bent; left fist stays clear.
6. LEFTWARD strike endpoint: lead right fist crosses in front of body and extends to screen-left at waist/chest height, torso rotated toward screen-left, head looks left, left balancing hand behind/right of chest; clear physical followthrough. BOTH legs visible continuously, soles anchored. No mirroring costume or swapping arms.
Keep actual right/left arms anatomically consistent and visible. Three repetitions of this 6-pose cycle will form THREE ROUNDS, six alternating impacts, later in composition.
transfer:
Create a 6-frame 3x2 transparent BODY sprite sheet, 1536x1024, cells512x512, same approved Kennyo03 character as references. Input1 is his chanting sequence; input2 is his necklace-free attack body. Exact same narrow face/beard, white hood, dark armor/robe, gold side cloth, legs and proportions. NO BROWN NECKLACE ANYWHERE IN ANY FRAME: it will be an independent layer. No beads, ropes, weapons, magic, text, shadows or background. Same hand-painted game style and fixed right-facing camera. Standing equivalent height457 pixels, crown near y17 and feet near y474, identical bones/head size across frames, both feet stable on ground, no bounding-box rescaling. Every hand/foot/hood fits fully.
This is the continuous necklace take-off / replace transition, gripping an invisible flexible loop that is NOT drawn:
1 upright prayer, palms pressed together at chest, head slightly bowed chanting, arms relaxed.
2 open palms to the sides of neck/collarbones, fingers curl as if taking hold of the two sides of the neck loop; head looks slightly down, elbows out.
3 both hands lift above and just outward from the top of hood, pulling the invisible loop OVER THE HEAD; hands visible, shoulders and elbows naturally connected, body upright. Show clear above-head clearance for the necklace to pass.
4 both hands lower together to chest level toward screen-right, holding an invisible loop in front of his body after taking it off; head turns right.
5 lead hand lifts to screen-left shoulder preparing a wide whipping strike, rear hand guards sternum, torso turns slightly left, planted feet.
6 after the attack, both hands in front of chest holding the imaginary loop ready to lift it back over his hood; upright recovery stance. No actual necklace drawn.
Maintain all limb continuity; no extra hands; not a praying statue or different outfit.
bead: Create one small game asset: a single spherical oversized dark polished brown wooden Buddhist prayer bead, isolated on GENUINE TRANSPARENT background, no background or shadow. The bead matches the dark wood necklace in the reference exactly in color/material, warm brown hand-painted 2D game sprite style with crisp contour and restrained upper-left warm highlight, no photorealism. Perfect round compact silhouette, slight wood grain, central drilled hole a tiny dark opening at top and bottom. One bead centered with empty alpha margin, no cord, no multiple beads, no text, no hands or person. It will be repeated on an independently animated prayer-bead chain.
